steps: 1. Preserve the checked repairs and recover from current files. The implementation role should update P08/progress.md with this plan, the new EU archive and remaining acceptance work. Preserve historical source bytes, failed-access records, preparation archives, accepted evidence and protected supervisor files. Limit changes to P08 code/checks/tests, its three permitted output files and new versioned supporting research records.

2. Record the evidence contract and assumption audit before implementation. Question: do independently inspected applicable EU provisions support the matched bond lifecycle? Comparators are the existing admitted AASB treatment and independently derived contractual cash-flow arithmetic. Acceptance requires applicable primary support, complete operation semantics, both matched outcomes and reproducible artifacts. Missing relevant authority vetoes comparator admission; invalid calculations, provenance or state transitions veto engineering acceptance. Test counts and numerical agreement are explanatory only. Record provenance, justification, failure mode, early diagnostic and status for each material assumption. Reserve the final 120 seconds for checks and reporting.

3. Complete the EU applicability dossier from retained inputs first. Inspect the four amendment annexes, relevant IAS 32 eligibility cross-references, IFRS 9 measurement/derecognition provisions and IFRS 7 note provisions. Establish the synthetic reporting context using applicable EU adoption/scope authority, including Regulation 1606/2002 where required. Build a provision-level matrix covering 2024 and 2025 reporting periods and every event date: source edition, effective date, transition, early-adoption assumption, applicability and exact supporting passage. Inspect relevant amendments/corrigenda identified by retained metadata; do not dismiss them from titles or publication dates alone. Preserve the corrected regulation date and original text separately.

4. Retrieve only missing applicable primary material through legitimate official routes, using the known successful Publications Office route and exact metadata links. Apply a 30-second request timeout, at most two distinct routes per missing document and a 180-second aggregate retrieval budget. Do not repeat unchanged failed endpoints or bypass challenges. Record source-specific failures once and continue local inspection and engineering preparation. Unresolved material applicability prevents EU admission; it does not invalidate the existing AASB slice. Do not silently shorten the case or switch comparison facts to avoid a dependency.

5. Create a new versioned authority register and inspection record referencing preserved sources. Separate EU and AASB claim namespaces and applicability contexts. Extend AuthorityBook admission, event/note dependencies and comparison dispatch explicitly by supported regime. Reuse numerical formulas only where independent EU anchors justify them. Preserve rejection of unknown eligibility, excluded features and unsupported periods before state mutation. Keep US GAAP and ASBE rows unresolved unless separately supported; retain their historical preparation.

6. Produce both EU outcomes using the existing facts: principal/proceeds/fair value 100, annual coupon 5, comparable yield 1/10, two annual periods, ten conversion shares and opening cash 20. Preserve dates, currency relationship, issuer economics, funding and conversion rights. Specify preconditions, recognition, measurement, journal/state effects and notes for issuance, each accrual/coupon, redemption and conversion. Independently derive initial liability and residual equity, annual interest/carrying amounts, settlement balances and shares. Explain supported equivalence or differences with paragraph anchors; never manufacture a numerical difference.

7. Extend validation and tests without weakening existing checks. Replace AASB-only claim expectations with regime-specific validated dependencies. Replay complete EU cases and recompute common-fact hashes independently. Validate source/register copies, amendment decisions, all manifest pins and operation/posting/note links. Test both outcomes, independently derived amounts, wrong reporting context, out-of-period sources, missing claims, stale EU hashes, altered applicability records, changed comparator economics and failed-event atomicity. Reject an EU label backed only by AASB claims. Allow an explicitly anchored agreement finding while keeping unsupported regimes null. Criterion 3 must require two fully supported lifecycle rows.

8. Regenerate authority-and-methods.json and result.md from actual checked executions. Include the applicability matrix, operation specification, both complete comparisons, source-linked interpretation, preserved access history, four-criterion status, decision table, limitations and existing six method queues. Retain the ACTUS defer decision unless its technical and official-code review is completed. Record commands, environment, wall time, source/code/test hashes, plan/result references and every changed file. Update progress.md after meaningful changes; do not rewrite protected requirements, master plans or frozen evidence.

9. Run CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_accounting_p08.py' -v and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 python3 -B scripts/check_accounting_p08.py --check. Verify required outputs, current manifest pins, protected hashes and changed-file scope. Fix failures and rerun affected checks within budget. Report engineering conformance separately from accounting applicability and phase acceptance. If source dependencies or checks remain unresolved, identify exact remaining provisions/files and preserve criterion 3 as incomplete.
